about: Paths the edge in front of blokmix.com sends to this app; everything else is the website. `patterns` are whole paths the app answers too: a mix's short address (blokmix.com/k3x9, Mix::SHORT_PATTERN). `/` goes to the app only with the cookie below (MarkSignedIn). tests/Feature/EdgePathsTest.php fails when a route isn't covered. The blokmix.com repo keeps a copy in worker/edge-paths.json.
